# Metacritic — reception overview and review leads

- Original source: [Metacritic — reception overview and review leads](https://www.metacritic.com/game/robin-hood-the-legend-of-sherwood/)
- Author / publication: Metacritic
- Language / date: English; dynamic listing checked 2026-09-09
- Access: Overview page retrieved directly
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Retrieved: 2026-09-09
- Archived copy: [Wayback Machine, 2026-07-01](http://web.archive.org/web/20260701214701/https://www.metacritic.com/game/robin-hood-the-legend-of-sherwood/)
- Format: header notes, original summary, then the complete listing data

The retrieved listing reports a critic aggregate of **80/100 from 15 reviews**. It includes favorable and mixed assessments rather than unanimous praise.

Its listed review leads include Yahoo! (90), GameSpy (87), Game Over Online (79), Pregaming (70), and Computer Games Magazine (60). The magazine citation points to February 2003, page 78. These are aggregator-reported scores; the original articles should be consulted before attributing detailed arguments to those publications.

The GameSpy excerpt emphasizes mission design, character abilities, and resource management. The Computer Games Magazine excerpt objects to frustration undermining the challenge.

**Limitations:** review counts and audience ratings can change. Aggregation does not independently establish gameplay facts, and a short excerpt is not a substitute for the original review.

## Complete listing data (retrieved 2026-09-09)

- Title: Robin Hood: The Legend of Sherwood; platform PC; rated T for Teen; released 14 November 2002; publisher Strategy First; developer Spellbound; genre Real-Time Tactics.
- **Metascore 80, "Generally Favorable", 15 critic reviews:** 11 positive (73%), 4 mixed (27%), 0 negative.
- **User score 8.5, "Generally Favorable", 144 ratings:** 121 positive (84%), 20 mixed (14%), 3 negative (2%).

Critic entries shown on the overview page (the full 15 are on the critic-reviews sub-page):

| 86 | GameSpot | Gets its subject right, with playability, storytelling and atmosphere | gamespot.com review 2897317 |

User reviews visible on the overview page: LT_Gruber 10 (19 Apr 2025, spoiler-tagged), jacobredolig 10 (18 May 2024, German; loved it as a child, high replay value, camp building and varied locations), BB16toe 10 (24 Sep 2023, spoiler-tagged), SoulsReaper 10 (30 Jun 2020, childhood favourite), RaminGray 10 (7 May 2016), GolovA 7 (8 May 2017; good story and voices, mechanics now cumbersome), Freez 1 (7 Nov 2011; Steam version unplayable on multi-core machines, demo worked, no patch after six months).
